title: 隧道湧水排導系統~Tunnel inflow collection and drainage
focus: 用流量收支、重力排水與泵站備援管理隧道湧水~Manage tunnel inflow through flow balance, gravity drainage and pump redundancy
summary: 本課以用流量收支、重力排水與泵站備援管理隧道湧水為主線，從地下水與施工用水收支與支管流速與有效斷面建立系統邊界，再把集水容量與反應時間、堵塞敏感度與維護連到長期水文與維護交接。排水降低局部水頭，也可能改變鄰地有效應力與水資源邊界。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。~This course focuses on manage tunnel inflow through flow balance, gravity drainage and pump redundancy. It begins with Groundwater and process-water balance and Branch velocity and effective area, links Sump storage and response time and Blockage sensitivity and maintenance, and ends with Long-term hydrology and handover. Drainage lowers local head but may also change surrounding effective stress and water-resource boundaries. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.

units.anchor: 地下水與施工用水收支~Groundwater and process-water balance
units.title: 地下水與施工用水收支~Groundwater and process-water balance
units.mechanism: 排水總量同時包含地層湧水、施工用水和儲存變化，不能全部算成天然地下水。泵站啟停造成出水脈動，應在相同時間窗比較流入與流出；若水槽水位改變，還須加入庫容項才可辨認真正湧水趨勢。 判別這個機制時，應觀察同步記錄總出水、施工用水與集水槽水位變化；若出現施工用水增加被誤判為地層突湧，導致錯誤地質處置，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Discharge combines groundwater, process water and storage change rather than natural inflow alone. Pump cycling makes outlet flow intermittent, requiring equal accounting windows. Include changing sump volume to identify the underlying groundwater trend instead of confusing operational pulses with geology. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Synchronize total discharge, process-water use and sump-level changes. If higher process-water use is mistaken for groundwater inflow and prompts the wrong geological response, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Qground=Qout-Qprocess=80 L/s-25 L/s=55 L/s at constant storage。排水降低局部水頭，也可能改變鄰地有效應力與水資源邊界。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: Qground=Qout-Qprocess=80 L/s-25 L/s=55 L/s at constant storage. Drainage lowers local head but may also change surrounding effective stress and water-resource boundaries. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.
units.verify: 同步記錄總出水、施工用水與集水槽水位變化。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「施工用水增加被誤判為地層突湧，導致錯誤地質處置」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。~Synchronize total discharge, process-water use and sump-level changes. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Higher process-water use is mistaken for groundwater inflow and prompts the wrong geological response. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.
units.failure: 施工用水增加被誤判為地層突湧，導致錯誤地質處置。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到同步記錄總出水、施工用水與集水槽水位變化，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。~Higher process-water use is mistaken for groundwater inflow and prompts the wrong geological response. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to synchronize total discharge, process-water use and sump-level changes to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If higher process-water use is mistaken for groundwater inflow and prompts the wrong geological response, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 支管流速與有效斷面~Branch velocity and effective area
units.title: 支管流速與有效斷面~Branch velocity and effective area
units.mechanism: 支管輸水能力受實際有效斷面影響，沉積、變形和局部堵塞都會改變速度與水位。用公稱管徑計算可能漏掉積泥，量測高流速也不一定表示容量充足，因為上游可能已積水；應同時看流量、斷面與水頭。 判別這個機制時，應觀察量測流速、積泥厚度及上游水位以還原有效斷面；若出現積泥縮小斷面導致水位抬升，名義管徑仍看似足夠，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Branch performance depends on effective area altered by sediment, deformation and blockage. Nominal diameter can miss deposits, and high velocity does not prove spare capacity if water is already backing up. Interpret flow, section geometry and head together rather than velocity alone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Measure velocity, deposit depth and upstream level to reconstruct effective area. If sediment reduces area and raises head while nominal diameter still appears adequate, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Q=A*v=0.020 m2*0.8 m/s=0.016 m3/s=16 L/s。排水降低局部水頭，也可能改變鄰地有效應力與水資源邊界。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: Q=A*v=0.020 m2*0.8 m/s=0.016 m3/s=16 L/s. Drainage lowers local head but may also change surrounding effective stress and water-resource boundaries. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

units.anchor: 重力管線與坡度~Gravity pipe and gradient
units.title: 重力管線與坡度~Gravity pipe and gradient
units.mechanism: 重力排水依靠水面或能量坡降，管底設計坡度不一定等於實際水力坡降。接頭錯台與局部反坡會形成積泥，端點高程正確也可能漏掉中段低窪；Manning 模型只在定義清楚的均勻流條件下提供基準。 判別這個機制時，應觀察沿線水準與管內影像共同查核反坡、錯台及沉積；若出現中段沉陷形成水袋，兩端坡度合格卻持續堵塞，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Gravity drainage follows a water-surface or energy gradient, which need not equal the designed invert grade. Steps and reverse slopes trap sediment despite correct endpoints. Manning's equation gives a baseline only under a clearly defined uniform-flow condition, not arbitrary backwater or pressurized flow. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Use longitudinal levels and internal images to check reverse slopes, steps and deposits. If a midline sag traps water and repeatedly blocks despite acceptable endpoint grade, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 泵站揚程與耗能~Pump head and power
units.title: 泵站揚程與耗能~Pump head and power
units.mechanism: 泵站需要克服靜揚程、沿程損失及局部損失，額定流量只對應特定工作點。效率隨工況改變，不能將馬達功率直接等同水力輸出；並聯泵也不一定讓流量倍增，因為系統曲線會隨流量上升。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較實測流量、吸排壓差與輸入功率對應工作點；若出現沿程阻力增大把泵推離有效工況，耗電高但排水不足，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Pumps overcome static lift, friction and local losses, with rated flow tied to a duty point. Efficiency changes with operation, so motor power is not hydraulic output. Parallel pumps need not double discharge because the system curve rises with total flow. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare measured flow, suction-discharge pressure difference and input power at the duty point. If growing line resistance shifts duty away from efficient operation, using power without adequate drainage, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Drainage lowers local head but may also change surrounding effective stress and water-resource boundaries. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

units.anchor: 集水容量與反應時間~Sump storage and response time
units.title: 集水容量與反應時間~Sump storage and response time
units.mechanism: 集水槽提供短暫流量緩衝，實際可用容量要扣除沉積、最低運轉水位與不可用空間。以總幾何容積除湧水量會高估反應時間，泵停機後流入也可能變化；需使用可用容量和明確情境，而非把時間當成工作許可。 判別這個機制時，應觀察核對槽內有效水位區間、沉積量及停泵水位上升紀錄；若出現沉積佔用緩衝容量，停機後比預估更快溢流，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~A sump buffers temporary imbalance, with usable storage reduced by sediment, minimum operating levels and dead space. Gross volume divided by inflow overstates response time, while inflow can change after pump failure. Use available storage under a stated scenario rather than treating the time as permission to act. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check usable level range, sediment and observed level rise during approved pump tests. If sediment consumes buffer storage and overflow occurs sooner than predicted, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 備援容量與共同失效~Redundancy and common failures
units.title: 備援容量與共同失效~Redundancy and common failures
units.mechanism: 備用泵能處理單機故障，卻不能自動解決共用電源、吸水口或排水幹管失效。備援評估應沿完整鏈找共同點，並檢查切換期間儲存量；設備數量多不代表功能獨立，需要以故障情境而非台數證明韌性。 判別這個機制時，應觀察逐一核對電源、控制、吸水和排水共用點及切換試驗；若出現全部泵共用堵塞吸水口，備用機雖正常也無法排水，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~A standby pump addresses one unit's failure but not shared power, intake or discharge-line loss. Trace common dependencies and storage during transfer. More equipment does not establish functional independence; demonstrate resilience through failure scenarios rather than pump count alone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Audit shared power, control, intake and discharge points alongside transfer tests. If all pumps share a blocked intake, so a healthy standby still cannot drain, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：remainingCapacity=2*40 L/s=80 L/s after one of three equal pumps fails。排水降低局部水頭，也可能改變鄰地有效應力與水資源邊界。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: remainingCapacity=2*40 L/s=80 L/s after one of three equal pumps fails. Drainage lowers local head but may also change surrounding effective stress and water-resource boundaries. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.
units.verify: 逐一核對電源、控制、吸水和排水共用點及切換試驗。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「全部泵共用堵塞吸水口，備用機雖正常也無法排水」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。~Audit shared power, control, intake and discharge points alongside transfer tests. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: All pumps share a blocked intake, so a healthy standby still cannot drain. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.
units.failure: 全部泵共用堵塞吸水口，備用機雖正常也無法排水。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到逐一核對電源、控制、吸水和排水共用點及切換試驗，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。~All pumps share a blocked intake, so a healthy standby still cannot drain. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to audit shared power, control, intake and discharge points alongside transfer tests to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.
units.misconception: 多裝一台備用泵就能排除所有排水失效~Adding one standby pump eliminates every drainage failure
units.practice: 將逐一核對電源、控制、吸水和排水共用點及切換試驗列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現全部泵共用堵塞吸水口，備用機雖正常也無法排水，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。~Apply the following check at handover: Audit shared power, control, intake and discharge points alongside transfer tests. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If all pumps share a blocked intake, so a healthy standby still cannot drain, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 堵塞敏感度與維護~Blockage sensitivity and maintenance
units.title: 堵塞敏感度與維護~Blockage sensitivity and maintenance
units.mechanism: 沉積會同時減少面積與水力半徑，輸水能力下降可能快於直徑比例。此直徑尺度關係假定幾何相似的圓形有效通道滿流，Manning n 與能量坡度不變；任意底部沉積形狀或部分滿流不能沿用同一冪次。清理效果應以恢復後水位和流量驗證，而不只看清出多少沉積物。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較清理前後有效斷面、水位與相同流量下壓降；若出現只清可見口部而保留深部堵塞，水位很快再次抬升，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Deposits reduce both area and hydraulic radius, making capacity fall faster than diameter alone. The scaling assumes geometrically similar circular effective passages flowing full, with unchanged Manning n and energy slope. Arbitrary bottom deposits or partially full flow do not follow the same diameter exponent. Verify cleaning by recovered head and flow rather than the removed sediment mass alone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare effective section, level and pressure loss at equal flow before and after cleaning. If cleaning only the visible outlet leaves deep blockage and head quickly rises again, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Drainage lowers local head but may also change surrounding effective stress and water-resource boundaries. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. units.anchor: 濾層與細粒流失~Filters and loss of fines
units.title: 濾層與細粒流失~Filters and loss of fines
units.mechanism: 排水需要讓水通過又限制地層細粒移動，濾層不相容會引起內部侵蝕或快速堵塞。出水突然變濁可能反映顆粒流失，但施工泥水也能造成類似現象；應結合粒徑、流量和地表變形，避免只以清澈程度判定穩定。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比對濾層粒徑、濁度、排水量與附近沉陷趨勢；若出現細粒被帶走形成隱藏空洞，出水量正常仍可能損失地層，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Drainage must pass water while retaining ground fines; incompatible filters can erode internally or clog quickly. Turbidity may indicate soil loss but also construction slurry. Combine particle distribution, flow and ground movement rather than judging stability solely from water clarity. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare filter grading, turbidity, discharge and nearby settlement trends. If escaping fines create hidden voids despite apparently normal discharge, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：gradient=deltaHead/pathLength=2 m/0.5 m=4, requiring soil-specific assessment。排水降低局部水頭，也可能改變鄰地有效應力與水資源邊界。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: gradient=deltaHead/pathLength=2 m/0.5 m=4, requiring soil-specific assessment. Drainage lowers local head but may also change surrounding effective stress and water-resource boundaries. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

units.anchor: 水質負荷與排放處理~Water-quality load and treatment
units.title: 水質負荷與排放處理~Water-quality load and treatment
units.mechanism: 排水水質管理應同時看濃度和流量，低濃度的大流量仍可能有很大污染物質量。沉澱槽處理懸浮固體不等於去除溶解物，應按成分選擇驗證量；課程的質量帳只描述工程尺度，不取代所在地排放要求。 判別這個機制時，應觀察同步取樣流量與代表性濃度並比較處理前後質量收支；若出現只看濃度降低忽略稀釋增流，總污染質量其實未下降，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Water management needs both concentration and flow: dilute high-volume discharge can carry a large mass. Settling removes suspended solids rather than every dissolved species, requiring constituent-specific verification. The mass balance describes engineering scale and does not replace local discharge requirements. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Sample representative concentration and flow together and compare treatment mass balances. If concentration falls through dilution while total discharged contaminant mass remains unchanged, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 長期水文與維護交接~Long-term hydrology and handover
units.title: 長期水文與維護交接~Long-term hydrology and handover
units.mechanism: 隧道排水可能長期改變周邊地下水位，運轉資料需要與降雨、泉水和鄰地沉陷共同解讀。不同季節的同一流量不一定代表相同地層狀態，感測器和排水改造也會改變基準；交接應保存來源分區和維護歷程。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將降雨、地下水位、分區排水與清理事件共同分析；若出現把季節乾旱全歸因隧道排水，或忽略持續抽排的影響，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Tunnel drainage can alter regional groundwater over time, requiring interpretation with rainfall, springs and settlement. Equal seasonal flows need not represent equal ground conditions, while sensor or drainage changes shift baselines. Preserve source zones and maintenance history for later assessment. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Analyze rainfall, groundwater levels, zoned discharge and cleaning events together. If seasonal drought is entirely blamed on drainage, or persistent drainage effects are ignored, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

example: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查地下水與施工用水收支：Qground=Qout-Qprocess=80 L/s-25 L/s=55 L/s at constant storage；再獨立檢查支管流速與有效斷面：Q=A*v=0.020 m2*0.8 m/s=0.016 m3/s=16 L/s。總排水保持 80 L/s，施工用水由 25 增為 35 L/s，推估地層湧水由 55 降為 45 L/s；總量不變可能掩蓋來源改變。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為排水降低局部水頭，也可能改變鄰地有效應力與水資源邊界。 將比對濾層粒徑、濁度、排水量與附近沉陷趨勢作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。~All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Groundwater and process-water balance: Qground=Qout-Qprocess=80 L/s-25 L/s=55 L/s at constant storage. Independently check Branch velocity and effective area: Q=A*v=0.020 m2*0.8 m/s=0.016 m3/s=16 L/s. At a constant total discharge of 80 L/s, process water rising from 25 to 35 L/s reduces inferred groundwater inflow from 55 to 45 L/s; unchanged totals can conceal changing sources. The two results are not a complete design because drainage lowers local head but may also change surrounding effective stress and water-resource boundaries. Use compare filter grading, turbidity, discharge and nearby settlement trends as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
history: 本課討論的用流量收支、重力排水與泵站備援管理隧道湧水，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。排水降低局部水頭，也可能改變鄰地有效應力與水資源邊界。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。哥達與英法海底隧道僅作地質及地下水邊界的比較，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。~The focus on manage tunnel inflow through flow balance, gravity drainage and pump redundancy reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. Drainage lowers local head but may also change surrounding effective stress and water-resource boundaries. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. Gotthard and the Channel Tunnel are comparisons of geological and groundwater boundaries only. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.
